title: Primitives: buttons, inputs, selects, switch and badges
goal: Global button, input, select and .toggle styles are replaced by bricks primitives on every screen
acceptance: Primary, ghost, danger and small buttons use the bricks button; inputs and selects use bricks input and select; switches use the bricks toggle with role=switch kept; status dots use badge
The global rules for these in styles.scss are removed; no local override of a bricks component
Client specs pass; disabled states, focus and aria-invalid still shown
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take Grover's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: about 75 buttons, 78 inputs and 23 selects across 15 templates, mostly mechanical. Not a measurement.
